'''Apricot's Valentine''' (Japanese: '''小梅のバレンタイン''' ''{{tt|Koume|Apricot}}'s Valentine'') is the fifty-eighth chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Apricot]] makes candy to give to [[Walnut]] for Valentine's Day but, during {{pkmn|training}}, she finds out there's already a girl he's in love with. She doesn't know that he's actually in love with Apricot's unmasked form.
